| Category = Stew recipes

}}

{{recipe}}

==Ingredients==
*about 1 [[Cookbook:Pound|pound]] (450 [[Cookbook:Gram|g]]) stewing [[Cookbook:beef|beef]], cut in bite-sized pieces
*about ¼ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] (30 g) [[Cookbook:flour|flour]]
*[[Cookbook:Salt|Salt]], to taste
*[[Cookbook:pepper|Pepper]], to taste
*1 [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|teaspoon]] [[Cookbook:butter|butter]] or [[Cookbook:margarine|margarine]]
*3–4 large [[Cookbook:onions|onions]], [[Cookbook:Slicing|sliced]] in rings
*5 whole [[Cookbook:Clove|cloves]]
*2 [[Cookbook:Bay Leaf|bay leaves]]
*1 cube of beef [[Cookbook:Bouillon Cube|bouillon]] or 1 ½ tsp powdered [[Cookbook:Stock|stock]], combined with 1 [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] [[Cookbook:Water|water]]
*1 [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] (250 [[Cookbook:Milliliter|ml]]) warm water
*2 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tbsp]] white [[Cookbook:vinegar|vinegar]]
*1 bottle of dark [[Cookbook:beer|beer]] or 12 [[Cookbook:Ounce|ounces]] of beef stock

==Procedure==
#Combine flour, salt, and pepper. [[Cookbook:Dredging|Dredge]] meat pieces in this mixture.
#Melt butter in heavy pan, add meat, and [[Cookbook:Searing|sear]] until lightly browned.
#Add onions and seasonings. Cook, stirring, until onions start to get translucent.
#Stir together water and bouillon cube/powder until well-dissolved. Add to meat/onion mixture along with vinegar and beer.
#Bring to a [[Cookbook:Boiling|boil]], then lower heat and let [[Cookbook:Simmering|simmer]] about 3 hours until meat is tender. Stir occasionally to avoid scorching.
#Check seasoning, and add salt and pepper if needed.
#Serve over cooked [[Cookbook:Rice|rice]].
